## What this changes

One or two sentences. Link the issue it answers (`Closes #…`).

## Why

What the founder needed that the current behaviour did not give them.

## Checks

- [ ] One concern per pull request; the changed reference file reads well from the top.
- [ ] No invented facts, quotes, awards, endorsements or affiliations introduced anywhere, including examples.
- [ ] The skill still only drafts: nothing sends, posts or publishes.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, figures or personal details about a real person.
- [ ] `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` still parses; `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" if users would notice the change.
